ACTION BY UNANIMOUS WRITTEN CONSENT
OF THE BOARD OF DIRECTORS OF
HALCYON INSTRUMENTS, INC.
(a Delaware corporation)

June 30, 2026

The undersigned, being all of the members of the Board of Directors (the "Board") of Halcyon Instruments, Inc., a Delaware corporation (the "Corporation"), acting by unanimous written consent in lieu of a meeting pursuant to Section 141(f) of the General Corporation Law of the State of Delaware and the Bylaws of the Corporation, hereby consent to, adopt, and approve the following resolutions with the same force and effect as if they had been duly adopted at a meeting of the Board duly called and held, and direct that this consent be filed with the minutes of the proceedings of the Board.

APPROVAL OF THE 2026 EQUITY INCENTIVE PLAN

WHEREAS, the Board has determined that it is in the best interests of the Corporation and its stockholders to adopt an equity incentive plan under which employees, directors, and consultants of the Corporation may be granted equity awards;

WHEREAS, the Board has reviewed the form of the Halcyon Instruments, Inc. 2026 Equity Incentive Plan (the "Plan") and the forms of award agreement thereunder, each presented to the Board and attached hereto as Exhibit A;

NOW, THEREFORE, BE IT:

RESOLVED, that the Plan, in substantially the form attached as Exhibit A, is hereby adopted and approved, and that 4,250,000 shares of the Corporation's Common Stock are hereby reserved for issuance thereunder;

RESOLVED FURTHER, that the Plan is adopted subject to, and shall become effective upon, approval by the stockholders of the Corporation within twelve (12) months after the date of this consent, and that if such approval is not obtained the Plan and all awards granted under it shall be void ab initio;

RESOLVED FURTHER, that the Compensation Committee of the Board is designated as the administrator of the Plan with full authority to grant awards, to determine the terms of each award, and to construe and interpret the Plan, subject to the limitations set forth therein.

GRANT OF STOCK OPTIONS

WHEREAS, the Board has reviewed the recommendation of the Compensation Committee that options be granted to the individuals named on Schedule 1;

WHEREAS, the Board has received and reviewed the independent valuation of the Corporation's Common Stock prepared by Whitcombe Valuation Advisors LLC as of May 31, 2026, which determined the fair market value of a share of Common Stock to be $2.14;

NOW, THEREFORE, BE IT:

RESOLVED, that the Board hereby determines that the fair market value of a share of Common Stock as of the date of this consent is $2.14 per share, and that such determination is made in good faith and in reliance on the independent valuation described above, in a manner intended to satisfy the presumption of reasonableness under Treasury Regulation § 1.409A-1(b)(5)(iv)(B);

RESOLVED FURTHER, that the Corporation hereby grants to each individual named on Schedule 1 an option to purchase the number of shares of Common Stock set forth opposite that individual's name, at an exercise price of $2.14 per share, subject to the terms of the Plan and the applicable award agreement;

RESOLVED FURTHER, that each such option shall vest as to twenty-five percent (25%) of the shares subject thereto on the first anniversary of the vesting commencement date set forth on Schedule 1, and as to 1/48th of the shares subject thereto monthly thereafter, subject to the holder's continuous service through each vesting date.

OFFICER APPOINTMENT

WHEREAS, the Board wishes to appoint a Chief Financial Officer of the Corporation;

NOW, THEREFORE, BE IT:

RESOLVED, that Ingrid Sørensen is hereby appointed Chief Financial Officer of the Corporation, effective July 6, 2026, to serve at the pleasure of the Board until her successor is duly appointed or until her earlier resignation or removal;

RESOLVED FURTHER, that the Corporation is authorized to enter into an indemnification agreement with Ms. Sørensen in the form previously approved by the Board for its officers and directors, and to include her as a covered person under the Corporation's directors' and officers' liability insurance policy.

BANKING AUTHORITY

RESOLVED, that Ingrid Sørensen, as Chief Financial Officer, is hereby authorized to open, maintain, and close accounts in the name of the Corporation at Cascadia Commerce Bank, N.A., to execute the bank's customary signature cards and account agreements, and to designate authorized signatories on such accounts, provided that any single disbursement in excess of $250,000 shall require the additional approval of the Chief Executive Officer.

GENERAL AUTHORITY

RESOLVED, that the officers of the Corporation are, and each of them acting alone is, hereby authorized and directed, in the name and on behalf of the Corporation, to execute and deliver all such further agreements, instruments, certificates, and documents, and to take all such further actions, as any of them may deem necessary or advisable to carry out the purposes and intent of the foregoing resolutions;

RESOLVED FURTHER, that all actions heretofore taken by the officers and directors of the Corporation in connection with the matters contemplated by the foregoing resolutions are hereby ratified, confirmed, and approved in all respects.

This consent may be executed in one or more counterparts, each of which shall be deemed an original and all of which together shall constitute one and the same instrument. Delivery of an executed counterpart by electronic transmission shall be as effective as delivery of a manually executed counterpart. This consent shall be filed with the minutes of the proceedings of the Board and shall be effective as of the date first written above.

IN WITNESS WHEREOF, the undersigned have executed this Action by Unanimous Written Consent as of the date first written above.

Rosalind Achebe, Director
